recognize_zh: 一大片以小至中型淋巴球為主的細胞群，許多核有明顯的切跡或裂溝（cleaved nuclei），細胞質稀少，與深染的小淋巴球混雜，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的中心細胞（centrocytes）。
features: Sheet of small to medium lymphoid cells with scant pale cytoplasm
Many nuclei with distinct clefts, notches, or indentations (cleaved nuclei)
Chromatin moderately condensed with inconspicuous nucleoli
Admixed small dark mature-appearing lymphocytes and occasional larger cells
Cohesive-appearing crowded aggregate, likely from a particle
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a crowded aggregate of lymphoid cells replacing normal hematopoietic elements in this field. The cells are small to medium sized with scant cytoplasm, and many show nuclear clefts and notches with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, admixed with small dark lymphocytes and occasional larger cells. Findings are consistent with involvement by a small cleaved B-cell lymphoma, compatible with follicular lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+ monotypic B cells) and biopsy is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mantle cells show more irregular but less deeply cleaved nuclei and are CD5+ cyclin D1+, whereas follicular lymphoma is CD10+ BCL6+ and CD5-.
CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like clumped chromatin and no clefts, with CD5+ CD23+ phenotype.
Hematogones have homogeneous smooth chromatin without clefting and show a maturing CD10/CD20/CD34 pattern on flow cytometry.
